responsibility: Declares helper APIs shared from the tree SSA math-optimization implementation. Its exported interface currently centers on building multiplication sequences for integer powers via powi_as_mults, supporting reassociation and other passes that want math-identity rewrites without depending on the full pass implementation.
same_name_distinction: Exports the narrow shared interface from the math-opts module, currently centered on powi_as_mults for building multiplication sequences. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-math-opts.cc, it does not implement the math optimization passes themselves.
